name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.63.1: Bound a direction's reach to one step so the map can be explored.
changelog.v2.63.0: Draw a tile pack, and a scene that reads one; Draw the basemap under the markers; Wrap a synthetic pack's columns, and make its output directory.
changelog.v2.62.0: Keep decoded tiles, and remember which ones are not there; Keep a hole when a tile claim is refused.
changelog.v2.61.1: Count the Map row when a scene walks the Nodes list.
changelog.v2.61.0: Decode a tile, with Wuffs vendored.
